title: Colorimetric quantification of sucrose in presence of thermo-sensitive polymers present in aqueous two-phase systems
author: Ramalakshmi, Ooi, et al.

steps.title: Prepare ice‑cold microplate
steps.instruction: Place a 96‑well microplate on ice and keep it at approximately 8 °C for the entire assay.

substeps.instruction: Place 96‑well plate on ice to maintain ~8 °C

steps.title: Add concentrated sulfuric acid
steps.instruction: Pipette 75 µL of concentrated sulfuric acid (96–98 %) into each well containing 3 µL of the sample mixture; the temperature will rise to about 32 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 75 µL 96–98 % H₂SO₄ to 3 µL sample mixture

steps.title: Add phenol solution
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL of 5 % (w/v) phenol to each well; the temperature will subsequently drop to roughly 23 °C.

steps.title: Mix and measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Shake the plate for about 5 minutes, then read the absorbance at 520 nm using a Sunrise (Tecan) microplate reader.

substeps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 520 nm with Sunrise Tecan reader

steps.title: Run reference assay at room temperature
steps.instruction: Perform the same sequence (acid addition, phenol addition, mixing, and absorbance reading) on reference samples at ambient room temperature instead of on ice, measuring absorbance at 520 nm.

substeps.instruction: Conduct steps 2‑4 at room temperature (no ice bath)
